title: Dolon Chapa
desc: Charan is a simple and honest man who is accused of a crime. Instead of accepting his fate, he fights for his innocence and tries to be acquitted of all charges.

title: Agnipath
desc: Sujay, Ajay and Bijay are three siblings who share a close bond and can go to any length to protect each other. However, when Sujay is killed by his own boss, Bijay sets out to exact revenge.

title: Pita Maata Santan
desc: Shikha and Pradeep's marital bliss is shattered when he takes their daughter, Jaya, away. A few years later, fate brings them face to face when Jaya becomes employed in Shikha's company.

title: Sangharsha
desc: In a village divided by corruption and power struggles between a politician and a doctor, honest newcomer Shubhankar challenges the status quo.
